Done. `out/T2/model.safetensors` is written and `out/T2/plan.yaml` + `out/T2/REPORT.md` are in place.

**Approach.** Head 5 of 16 (128 dims each) means dropping rows `640:768` of q/k/v and columns `640:768` of o_proj. `concat` only takes refs that resolve to exactly one tensor, so a concat-based solution would have meant 64 hand-written transforms. Instead the plan stays pattern-based — one rule per tensor role covers all 16 layers:

1. snapshot the two kept blocks into `tmpkeep.*` (sliced `copy` clones, so they're independent of the source);
2. `assign` the tail snapshot back over `[640:1920, :]`, closing the gap without an overlapping self-copy;
3. `copy` the leading `[:1920, :]` into a fresh contiguous tensor;
4. `delete` originals, `move` the new tensors into their names.

The snapshots are kept alive until after the value assertions, so the plan checks its own result block by block rather than only checking shapes; then they're deleted and the final count of 114 is asserted.

**Executions: 3, first success on the third.**

| # | class | message |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `failed_assertion` | `count failed: model::tmpkeep\..* matched 128 tensors, expected 80` — my own miscount of the snapshot tensors; the transforms were right |
| 2 | `crash` | `count.of matched zero tensors` — `count: {is: 0}` can't work, resolution errors before comparing. Replaced with `not: {exists: ...}` |
| 3 | — | clean |
